channel.title: Syracuse University News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Syracuse University News (news.syr.edu)

item.title: Syracuse Views Spring 2026
item.description: The latest views from every corner of Syracuse University's vibrant campus community.

item.title: Soaring Into Another Nesting Season
item.description: A newly installed camera atop Lyman Hall invites viewers to follow the day-to-day adventures of resident red-tailed hawks Oren and Ruth.

item.title: Whitman, Libraries Launch Information Literacy Certificate
item.description: The new digital badge program helps undergraduate and graduate business students build research and critical thinking skills for the AI-driven workplace.

item.title: Bill Coplin Retires After 56 Years of Shaping Maxwell Students
item.description: The legendary policy studies professor mentored tens of thousands of students and built a program rooted in real-world skills; a new endowed fund will carry his mission forward.

item.title: Gerry McNamara ’06 Named Head Coach of Syracuse University Men’s Basketball
item.description: A Syracuse legend returns home to lead the Orange. Gerry McNamara helped define Syracuse basketball. Now he'll lead it.

item.title: 8 Books You Should Read by Alumni, According to Creative Writing Faculty
item.description: Whether you’re looking to pick up a short story collection, poetry or a novel, these titles will entertain and captivate.

item.title: Creating Community Retreat Builds Campus Connections
item.description: The Office of People and Culture and Hendricks Chapel to host fourth annual retreat for staff, faculty and students in the fall of 2026.

item.title: Ukrainian Fulbright Scholar’s Mission: Support Veteran Reintegration at Home
item.description: Ukranian Fulbright scholar, Tetiana Pohorielova, center, is in the U.S. for six months studying at Syracuse University with research advisors affiliated with the Center for Behavioral Health Research and Innovation, Joseph Ditre, left, and Kenneth Marfilius, right.

item.title: Campus Supports Syracuse City School District Students
item.description: Through a campuswide clothing drive, 267 dress shirts and blouses were collected to help students dress their best at a career fair.

item.title: Brodsky Series Welcomes Expert for Map Conservation Lecture
item.description: Heather Hendry, senior paper conservator at the Conservation Center for Art and Historic Artifacts, will also lead a hands-on workshop on map lining techniques.
